title: Pick the Mixture, Not the Samples: Combinatorial Data Selection for LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.14028v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Data selection for LLM fine-tuning faces two facts about real training: data pools draw from many distinct domains, and evaluation spans diverse tasks. As a result, the same sample helps different tasks differently, and samples interact during training so that a subset's value is not the sum of its parts. Current data-selection methods leave these realities largely unaddressed. We formalize them as Combinatorial Data Selection (CDS), a framework that separates attribution (how samples are scored) from selection (which subset to pick) and models the non-additive interactions among samples. On a real instruction-tuning data pool, we find substantial cross-domain complementarity (joint utility exceeds the sum of singletons), alongside redundancy within domains. Inspired by this, we propose Mixture-then-Select, a two-stage algorithm that first decides how many samples to take from each domain, then ranks samples within each domain by attri

translated_title: 选择混合而非样本：面向大语言模型的组合式数据选择
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.14028v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：大语言模型微调中的数据选择面临真实训练中的两个事实：数据池来自许多不同的领域，而评估则涵盖多样的任务。因此，同一样本对不同任务的帮助程度各不相同，且样本在训练过程中会相互作用，使得一个子集的价值并非各部分价值的简单相加。现有的数据选择方法在很大程度上未能解决这些现实问题。我们将这些问题形式化为组合式数据选择（CDS），这是一个将归因（如何对样本进行评分）与选择（挑选哪个子集）分离开来的框架，并对样本之间的非加性交互进行建模。在一个真实的指令微调数据池上，我们发现了显著的跨领域互补性（组合效用超过单个样本效用之和），同时也存在领域内的冗余性。受此启发，我们提出了 Mixture-then-Select，这是一种两阶段算法，首先决定从每个领域选取多少样本，然后根据归因分数对每个领域内的样本进行排序……
tldr: 提出组合式数据选择（CDS）框架和"先定领域配比、再选样本"的两阶段算法 Mixture-then-Select，通过建模样本间非加性交互与跨领域互补性来改进大语言模型微调的数据选择。
en_tdlr: The paper formalizes Combinatorial Data Selection (CDS) for LLM fine-tuning—modeling non-additive sample interactions and cross-domain complementarity—and proposes Mixture-then-Select, a two-stage algorithm that first determines per-domain sample quotas and then ranks samples within each domain.
